extracted.intended_audience: NLP researchers and engineers building creative-plot-generation systems / ML researchers working on preference alignment for creative text
extracted.subtask_description: Generate coherent, premise-conditioned narrative plots (setup → development → climax → resolution) using resource-efficient Small Language Models (SLMs) aligned via structured preference signals and evaluative criteria. The page describes a three-component framework (aspect rating reward model, DPO-aligned MoE plot generator, and independent agentic evaluator) and the metrics used to construct, train, and validate it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative Quality Dimensions (NQDs) — overview
rubrics_metrics.description: A compact set of five narrative quality dimensions used as the core evaluative axes: character development, tone consistency, pacing, narrative coherence, and emotional turning points.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These five aspects were chosen to span structural (coherence), temporal (pacing), character-centric (development), stylistic (tone consistency), and affective (emotional turning points) components of plot quality; they are the primary signals used for reward modeling, DPO preference construction, and agentic evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative Coherence (NQD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Measures global logical consistency and causal connectivity across events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate for logical progression, cause–effect consistency, absence of plot holes or contradictions, integration of subplots, and alignment of character motivations with later events. Used as an aspect score (0–10) in the Aspect Rating Reward Model and as a multi-criterion agentic evaluation (10 subcriteria summing to 10).

rubrics_metrics.name: Character Development (NQD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluates meaningful internal transformation of characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess presence of compelling character arcs, clear motivations, psychological depth, relational dynamics, and satisfying journeys. Scored 0–10 by the reward model and via the agentic evaluator's detailed criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pacing (NQD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assesses distribution of narrative progression and tension over time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check rhythm, scene progression, timing of plot events, transitions, and whether pacing supports tension and emotional beats. Scored 0–10 and inspected via the agentic evaluator's pacing subcriteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tone Consistency (NQD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Captures alignment between stylistic register and the given premise and internal tonal unity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detect abrupt or incongruent mood/genre/atmosphere shifts that disrupt immersion; assess dialogue style and genre–tone alignment. Scored 0–10 and elaborated through agentic criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional Turning Points (NQD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Identifies impactful affective transitions and the plausibility of emotional arcs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate the presence, strength, and plausibility of pivotal emotional moments and whether they produce meaningful internal change; scored 0–10 and decomposed in agentic evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positive–Negative Prompting (aspect rating method)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each aspect, elicit two ratings from LLMs: a positive-only rating r+ (consider only positives) and a negative-only rating r− (consider only negatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mitigates LLM positivity bias, encourages critical assessment, and yields stronger correlation with external quality indicators. Use an ensemble of LLMs to avoid single-model bias; r+ should 'score generously' and r− should emphasize issues. Final aspect rating ra(p) is aggregated across models as sum_m (r+_a,m(p) − r−_a,m(p)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Aspect rating aggregation formula
rubrics_metrics.description: Aggregate per-model positive and negative scores to a single aspect rating: ra(p) = sum_m (r+_{a,m}(p) − r−_{a,m}(p)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use an ensemble (the paper uses five models) to mitigate individual-model bias. The aggregated score is continuous and used as the reward signal for preference creation and reward-model supervision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aspect Rating Reward Model — target output
rubrics_metrics.description: A model fine-tuned to predict continuous-valued aspect-level ratings (typically on a 0–10 scale) for each NQD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trained via supervised fine-tuning on synthetic aspect-rated data constructed via positive–negative prompting; used to score generated plots and to build high-confidence preference pairs for DPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aspect-rating dataset construction (data curation rules)
rubrics_metrics.description: Construct dataset by sampling movies (paper: 5,000 from MovieLens), scraping Wikipedia plots (filter: plot length ≤ 4000 words), generating synthetic aspect ratings via LLM ensemble positive–negative prompting, and aggregating them into continuous aspect scores.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IMDb ratings are only used for stratification and not as direct aspect labels. The length filter (≤4000 words) is applied for token/output/computation constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reward-model training objective (SFT losses)
rubrics_metrics.description: Supervised fine-tuning minimizes a weighted sum of Cross-Entropy (CE) token loss and a Huber regression loss to predict continuous aspect ratings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CE preserves language modeling capability; Huber loss (δ = 1 in experiments) provides robust learning of continuous-valued rewards (behaves like MSE near zero residuals and MAE for large residuals).

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic Evaluation — independence principle
rubrics_metrics.description: Independent post-hoc evaluation module that operates separately from the reward model and training pipeline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed to emulate human critical judgment and avoid circular validation / reward hacking; performs structured, multi-criteria reasoning across NQDs using explicit instructions and interpretable failure modes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation aggregation rule (per-NQD scoring)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each NQD, decompose evaluation into 10 explicit criteria; each criterion is scored 0–1 (increments of 0.1 allowed) and scores are summed to produce a total out of 10.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables fine-grained, interpretable assessment; agentic prompts provide the per-criterion checklist and output format. Outputs include per-criterion scores and a TOTAL: X.X/10.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluator output format requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Agentic evaluation returns per-criterion numeric scores (e.g., 'Plot Progression: X.X') and a summed TOTAL: X.X/10.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompts specify strict formatting to ensure consistent, machine-parseable evaluation records used in experiments and analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: DPO preference pair curation thresholds
rubrics_metrics.description: Select high-confidence preference samples where any frontier model achieves the highest reward score, the score ≥ 8, and the model outperforms the next-best model by margin ≥ 0.5.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applied across generated candidate plots per premise; results in a modest but high-confidence dataset (paper reports 160 samples) used for Direct Preference Optimization fine-tuning.

rubrics_metrics.name: SLM definition (active parameter criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Small Language Models (SLMs) are defined as models with ≤ 3 billion active parameters per token.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Active parameter count (per-token) is used rather than total parameter count; MoE architectures with large total parameters can be SLMs if active-per-token ≤ 3B (example: Qwen-3-30B-A3B: 30B total, 3B active).

rubrics_metrics.name: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) as efficiency/quality design choice
rubrics_metrics.description: Use MoE backbone to achieve higher total capacity while keeping active parameters per token within SLM bounds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MoE enables expert specialization and sparse computation, important for modeling diverse narrative patterns while meeting SLM compute constraints; used as the PlotTwist generator backbone.

rubrics_metrics.name: DPO (Direct Preference Optimization) alignment objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Optimize the plot generator using DPO on curated high-confidence preference pairs rather than on-policy RL or explicit reward-model optimization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DPO reframes alignment as a classification over preference pairs and is chosen for stability and sample efficiency in resource-constrained settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality-adaptive generation behavior (desired property)
rubrics_metrics.description: Generation should scale intervention by input quality: light refinements for strong narratives, substantive restructuring for weak narratives, and moderate improvements for mid-quality inputs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as an empirical desideratum and validated by stratified experiments: PlotTwist should not uniformly inflate scores but apply intervention proportional to baseline quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of external validation corpora for evaluator calibration
rubrics_metrics.description: Validate reward and agentic evaluators by checking higher scores for a held-out high-quality corpus (101 Greatest Screenplays) than for a low-quality corpus (Razzies).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Balanced subsampling protocol is used to account for class imbalance; statistical tests (CIs, Welch’s t-tests, effect sizes) assess separation across NQDs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positive prompt strict output rules (r+)
rubrics_metrics.description: When eliciting positive-focused ratings, instruct the LLM to output a single JSON object with exactly one integer field (0–10), include only the aspect field, and 'score generously'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strict formatting ensures consistent automated parsing; positive prompts bias toward noting strengths in the plot for that aspect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Negative prompt strict output rules (r−)
rubrics_metrics.description: When eliciting negative-focused ratings, instruct the LLM to output a single JSON object with exactly one integer field (0–10), include only the aspect field, and interpret 0 = no issues, 10 = severe issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Negative prompts bias toward identifying failure modes and issues for that aspect; combined with r+ this enables the aggregate ra(p) calculation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aspect score numeric scale
rubrics_metrics.description: Aspect ratings and agentic evaluation totals use a 0–10 numeric scale (continuous for reward model; summed per-criterion for agentic evaluator).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reward model predicts continuous values; agentic evaluator sums 10 criteria (each 0–1) to produce total out of 10. Many experiments report mean ± std on this 0–10 scale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Narrative Coherence subcriteria: Plot Progression
rubrics_metrics.description: Plot Progression: logical beginning–middle–end flow; events arise naturally from prior actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scored 0–1 as part of the 10-criterion coherence rubric; contributes to the TOTAL/10.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Narrative Coherence subcriteria: Causal Connectivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Causal Connectivity: explicit cause–effect links between events across the plot.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; detect missing causal links or unexplained jumps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Narrative Coherence subcriteria: Plot Integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Plot Integrity: absence of plot holes or contradictions; internal consistency of world-building.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; penalize contradictions and unresolved impossibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Narrative Coherence subcriteria: Conflict Focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Conflict Focus: a sustained central conflict that drives the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; evaluate whether the plot maintains a central dramatic question or dissipates into unrelated events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Narrative Coherence subcriteria: Protagonist Consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: Protagonist Consistency: protagonist's actions and decisions are authentic and consistent with characterization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; penalize unexplained behavior shifts that break causal/psychological plausibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Narrative Coherence subcriteria: Supporting Character Function
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting Character Function: supporting characters serve coherent narrative roles and contribute to main arcs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; penalize superfluous or functionless characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Narrative Coherence subcriteria: Resolution
rubrics_metrics.description: Resolution: satisfying and coherent wrapping up of central conflict and narrative threads.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; assess whether resolution follows logically and addresses major stakes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Narrative Coherence subcriteria: Pacing Appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.description: Pacing Appropriateness (within coherence rubric): pacing supports narrative flow and causal clarity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; identify rushed expositions or long digressions that harm coherence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Narrative Coherence subcriteria: Thematic Integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Thematic Integration: themes are consistently woven into events and character arcs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; penalize disconnected thematic signals or unresolved motifs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Narrative Coherence subcriteria: Tonal Consistency (coherence rubric)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tonal Consistency (as part of coherence scoring): tone supports logical immersion and doesn't undercut causal believability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; abrupt tone shifts that break coherence are penalized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Emotional Turning Point subcriteria: Conflict Resolution
rubrics_metrics.description: Conflict Resolution: the turning point addresses or reframes the central conflict; emotion aligns with the established arc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1 as part of the 10-criterion emotional-turning-point rubric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Emotional Turning Point subcriteria: Character Believability
rubrics_metrics.description: Character Believability: emotional reactions and stakes are credible given prior characterization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; check that emotional beats follow from established motivations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Emotional Turning Point subcriteria: Character Transformation
rubrics_metrics.description: Character Transformation: the turning point produces meaningful internal change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; assess whether the emotional pivot yields real arc progression.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Emotional Turning Point subcriteria: Emotional Satisfaction
rubrics_metrics.description: Emotional Satisfaction: the audience receives an emotionally resonant payoff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; consider catharsis, surprise-with-justification, and emotional completeness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Emotional Turning Point subcriteria: Narrative Causality
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative Causality: the turning point arises logically from prior events and motivations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; penalize contrived or deus-ex-machina emotional pivots.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Emotional Turning Point subcriteria: Thematic Crystallization
rubrics_metrics.description: Thematic Crystallization: the turning point sharpens or clarifies the story's thematic meaning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; evaluate whether emotion reinforces the theme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Emotional Turning Point subcriteria: Relationship Impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Relationship Impact: turning point affects key interpersonal relationships plausibly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; consider whether relationships change in believable ways.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Emotional Turning Point subcriteria: Cinematic Execution
rubrics_metrics.description: Cinematic Execution: the turning point could be effectively staged/visualized; attention to executional detail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; evaluates whether the turn translates into compelling scenes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Emotional Turning Point subcriteria: Structural Necessity
rubrics_metrics.description: Structural Necessity: the turning point is necessary for plot progression, not gratuitous.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; penalize turns that don't affect story outcome.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Emotional Turning Point subcriteria: Audience Alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Audience Alignment: the emotional turn matches likely audience expectations and reactions (given premise/genre).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; consider genre and premise in judging appropriateness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Character Development subcriteria: Motivation Clarity
rubrics_metrics.description: Motivation Clarity: characters have clear goals and desires.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; unclear or shifting motivations reduce score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Character Development subcriteria: Behavioral Consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: Behavioral Consistency: actions align with established personality and motivations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; penalize inexplicable behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Character Development subcriteria: Character Arc
rubrics_metrics.description: Character Arc: presence of believable, observable transformation over the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; assess magnitude and believability of change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Character Development subcriteria: Psychological Depth
rubrics_metrics.description: Psychological Depth: characters exhibit complexity, internal conflict, and layered motivations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; shallow or one-note characters score lower.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Character Development subcriteria: Backstory Integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Backstory Integration: backstory supports motivations and is integrated coherently.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; penalize irrelevant or contradictory backstory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Character Development subcriteria: Audience Connection
rubrics_metrics.description: Audience Connection: protagonist elicits empathy or interest appropriate to genre.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; consider whether readers/viewers care about the character's fate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Character Development subcriteria: Character Distinctiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Character Distinctiveness: characters have distinct voices and roles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; avoid generic or interchangeable characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Character Development subcriteria: Relationship Dynamics
rubrics_metrics.description: Relationship Dynamics: relationships evolve credibly and influence arcs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; evaluate mutual influence and narrative function.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Character Development subcriteria: Plot Agency
rubrics_metrics.description: Plot Agency: characters are agents who make consequential choices rather than passive objects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; penalize passive protagonists who merely react.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Character Development subcriteria: Thematic Alignment (character)
rubrics_metrics.description: Thematic Alignment: character development reinforces the story's themes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; check for coherence between character arcs and thematic statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Pacing subcriteria: Premise Establishment Speed
rubrics_metrics.description: Premise Establishment Speed: how quickly and effectively the premise and stakes are introduced.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; initial slowness or abrupt exposition is penalized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Pacing subcriteria: Structural Foundation
rubrics_metrics.description: Structural Foundation: presence of a sound story skeleton enabling even progression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; weak structural setup reduces pacing quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Pacing subcriteria: Pacing Consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: Pacing Consistency: absence of long stagnant segments or abrupt rushes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; look for uneven momentum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Pacing subcriteria: Event Frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: Event Frequency: appropriate density of events to sustain engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; too many trivial events or too few significant events are penalized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Pacing subcriteria: Scene Purposefulness
rubrics_metrics.description: Scene Purposefulness: each scene advances plot/character or builds theme; no filler.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; identify filler scenes that stagnate pacing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Pacing subcriteria: Tension Management
rubrics_metrics.description: Tension Management: build and release tension effectively across the arc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; evaluate rises and lulls in dramatic tension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Pacing subcriteria: Transition Quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Transition Quality: smooth and logical scene-to-scene transitions supporting momentum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; abrupt or jarring transitions reduce score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Pacing subcriteria: Emotional Beat Timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Emotional Beat Timing: placement of emotional moments to maximize impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; misplaced emotional beats weaken pacing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Pacing subcriteria: Climax Timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Climax Timing: climax arrives at a narratively justified point and is properly built up.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; premature or delayed climaxes are penalized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Pacing subcriteria: Genre–Tone Alignment (pacing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Genre–Tone Alignment: pacing is appropriate to the genre and tonal promises of the premise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; mismatch between genre expectations and pacing reduces score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Tone Consistency subcriteria: Initial Atmosphere Establishment
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial Atmosphere Establishment: clear initial tonal setting that orients the audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; weak or unclear openings fail to establish tone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Tone Consistency subcriteria: Scene-to-Scene Consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: Scene-to-Scene Consistency: tonal continuity across scenes, avoiding jarring shifts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; inconsistent register across scenes is penalized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Tone Consistency subcriteria: Tonal Relief Integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Tonal Relief Integration: moments of tonal relief (comic or quiet) are earned and integrated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; relief that undercuts stakes or feels unearned lowers score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Tone Consistency subcriteria: Earned Tone Shifts
rubrics_metrics.description: Earned Tone Shifts: any major tonal shifts are justified by plot/character developments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; abrupt unearned shifts are penalized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Tone Consistency subcriteria: Dialogue Style Consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: Dialogue Style Consistency: voice and register of dialogue remain consistent with tone and character.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; mismatched dialogue voice reduces tone score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Tone Consistency subcriteria: Visual Reinforcement
rubrics_metrics.description: Visual Reinforcement: sensory/visual descriptions consistently support the intended tone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; conflicting visual imagery undermines tone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Tone Consistency subcriteria: Stakes Alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Stakes Alignment: stakes set and maintained in tone (serious stakes in serious tone, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; tonal undercutting of stakes penalized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Tone Consistency subcriteria: Comedy/Drama Balance
rubrics_metrics.description: Comedy/Drama Balance: comedic elements (if present) are balanced with dramatic stakes as appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; inappropriate balance reduces immersion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Tone Consistency subcriteria: Ending Consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: Ending Consistency: the ending's tone aligns with the established tonal arc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; tonal whiplash at the end is penalized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic evaluation — Tone Consistency subcriteria: Motif and Symbol Unity
rubrics_metrics.description: Motif and Symbol Unity: recurring motifs/symbols support and reinforce the tone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Score 0–1; motif mismatch or absence weakens tonal unity.

rubrics_metrics.name: DPO sample-size and selection rationale
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a small set of high-quality preference pairs (paper: 160) for DPO to ensure reliable preference signals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-confidence curation (thresholds: reward ≥ 8 and margin ≥ 0.5) trades dataset size for signal quality; prior work shows DPO can leverage small numbers of high-quality pairs effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation validation protocol (statistical reporting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report mean ± standard deviation on 0–10 scales, bootstrap confidence intervals, Cohen's d effect sizes, directional consistency across sampling runs, and Welch's t-tests for statistical significance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use balanced subsampling when comparing imbalanced corpora, and report multiple statistical measures to demonstrate robust separation across NQDs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plot-length filter for training/evaluation corpora
rubrics_metrics.description: Only include plots with length ≤ 4000 words when scraping Wikipedia plots for dataset construction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applied to meet token output and computation requirements for downstream processing and LLM prompting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strict prompt-output format rules for automated pipelines
rubrics_metrics.description: When eliciting aspect scores from LLMs or agentic evaluators, strictly constrain outputs (JSON, only the requested field(s), numeric ranges) to ensure automated parsing and reliable supervision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompts in appendices specify exact output shapes (e.g., single JSON integer field) and scoring conventions; violating these formats invalidates synthetic labels and can bias supervised training.
